nodes.description: Owner address state variable of the Owned contract; controls all onlyOwner gated functions.
Declared newOwner address state variable; never assigned or read anywhere in this code.
Token symbol state variable, set to "TRVLR" in the constructor.
Token name state variable, set to "TRVLR" in the constructor.
Token decimals state variable, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply; initialised in the constructor and increased without cap by _mint.
Mapping address => balance mutated by the constructor, transfer, transferFrom and _mint.
Mapping owner => spender => allowance mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath addition helper with a c >= a check; redundant under pragma 0.8.3.
SafeMath subtraction helper requiring b <= a before computing a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper with a division-based overflow check.
SafeMath division helper requiring the divisor to be greater than zero.
Base constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
Initialises name, symbol, decimals, total supply and credits the whole supply to owner.
Public view returning the _totalSupply state variable.
Public view returning balances[tokenOwner] for an arbitrary address.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub for the sender and safeAdd for the recipient.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens; vulnerable to the classic approval race condition.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the caller's allowance via safeSub.
Public view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Writes the allowance, emits Approval and then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval before returning.
onlyOwner mint function increasing _totalSupply and the recipient balance with no supply cap.
Payable receive function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that forwards IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Caller-supplied address used for ownership assignment, balance and allowance indexing and as argument to external calls.
Untrusted external call to an arbitrary spender contract executed after the allowance state update; primary reentrancy vector.
Checked arithmetic performed in the SafeMath add/sub/mul/div helpers, guarded with require statements.
Unbounded supply arithmetic inside _mint: _totalSupply += amount and balances[account] += amount.
External call into an arbitrary token contract from transferAnyERC20Token; the returned boolean is forwarded unchecked.
